content:
With only a few weeks until the official unveiling of the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Fold, Apple is busy making preparations behind the scenes. According to the latest report from Bloomberg, Apple is holding a lottery for its U.S. retail employees, selecting staff to travel to California to help support the upcoming iPhone launch event in September.

iPhone launch event scheduled for September

The report states that Apple Store retail employees can apply to participate in the iPhone launch event, with duties including "assisting with crowd organization, checking in attending guests, welcoming attendees, providing directions, and supporting the security team."

Apple sent an internal memo to employees today announcing the lottery arrangements and stated that the event will be held in early September.

In the memo, Apple said the company is "thrilled to offer U.S. store team members the opportunity to participate in the event support experience program." For many years, Apple has relied on retail employees to help coordinate major product launches. According to the memo, employees who participated in this year's Worldwide Developers Conference or last year's iPhone launch event are not eligible to apply for this program. Interested employees must submit their applications by August 8, and Apple will notify selected candidates by August 17.

Apple typically holds its annual iPhone launch event during the second week of September. With U.S. Labor Day falling on September 7 this year, Bloomberg indicated that "a Wednesday event is slightly more likely, as this arrangement preserves Apple's traditional weekday travel window reserved for attendees."

If true, the iPhone launch event will be held on Wednesday, September 9. Pre-orders are expected to open that Friday, with the device officially going on sale one week later.
